selection.method: Read every uasset package metadata with SkipLoadingExports and SkipPreloadDependencyLoading; resolve each bIsAsset true, OuterIndex zero export ClassIndex through the import table and compare its asset-registry class.

scope.description: Original texture assets and six SourceContent images extracted from the supplied SideFX archive. Includes original diagnostic landscape textures/arrays and foliage textures. This extraction does not add external texture families or turn the archive placeholders into the final landscape PBR sets shown in the video.
